svg.text: BSW PE slice k: neighbour select + DP cell + step registers
h1/e1/f1/v1 = results of step t-1, h2/v2 = H of step t-2 (all PEs). Invalid neighbour (outside band / matrix): H = 0, E = F = -inf.
DP cell (combinational, same recurrence as SW)
edge PEs: index k-1 < 0 or k+1 >= B -> invalid
score desc, i asc, j asc
sw[k] = S[r+k]: shifts only on a DOWN move
tw[k] = T[c-k]: shifts only on a RIGHT move
